technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early reversal signals (stoch cross, OBV divergence) present, but severe downtrend structure (price below all MAs, bearish MACD, negative CMF) and lack of directional confirmation limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: WY shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 38 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (13/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale (322+ days old) with no recent conviction, and absent news sentiment limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (392.0), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and deteriorating credit conditions create severely unfavourable macro backdrop; earnings in 38 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI (9) with stochastic bullish cross and OBV divergence signal early reversal potential in fear-driven market (VIX crisis), offering contrarian entry near support at 28.53.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe downtrend structure (price below all major MAs, bearish MACD, negative CMF, no ADX confirmation) combined with unfavourable macro (VIX 392, rising dollar, credit stress) and high earnings risk in 38 days make this a weak swing entry with poor risk/reward.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme oversold RSI and stochastic bullish cross present contrarian appeal in a fear-driven market, the severe downtrend structure (price below all major MAs, bearish MACD, negative CMF) and unfavourable macro backdrop (VIX crisis, rising dollar, credit stress) create asymmetric risk that outweighs the reversal signal.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 38 days combined with VIX crisis (392) and deteriorating credit conditions could trigger further downside before any swing reversal materializes, invalidating the oversold bounce thesis.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 14 positions in Real Estate sector; adding WY increases concentration risk in a sector facing macro headwinds without sufficient conviction to justify the exposure.
